# Cornell University Department of Computer Science

> Cornell's top-ranked CS department spanning AI, robotics, theory, security, and computational biology research with world-class faculty and comprehensive undergraduate and PhD programs.

The Cornell Bowers Department of Computer Science is one of the leading computer science programs in the United States, offering rigorous undergraduate and graduate education alongside cutting-edge research across multiple disciplines. The department is known for faculty excellence, innovative research, and strong industry partnerships.

## Department Overview

- [Cornell: Computer Science](https://www.cs.cornell.edu): Cornell Bowers CS homepage showcasing AI, theory, robotics research and department excellence
- [About Us](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/about): Overview of Cornell CS department history, research areas, and leadership
- [Computer Science Leadership](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/leadership): Department leadership team with chair Lorenzo Alvisi and faculty governance
- [Computer Science Research Areas](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/research): Research overview in AI, robotics, security, computational biology, and theory
- [People Directory](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/directory): Faculty and staff directory searchable by research areas and expertise

## Academic Programs

- [Ph.D. in Computer Science](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/phd-computer-science): Top-ranked PhD program with research across all CS disciplines and comprehensive training
- [Prospective Students](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/prospective-students): Admissions resources for undergraduate and graduate programs with application information
- [Current Students](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/current-students): Resources for undergrad and grad students including planning, requirements, and support services
- [Graduate Student Support](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/graduate-student-support): Program advisors guide graduate students on course selection and career development

## Faculty and Staff

- [Current Faculty](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/current-faculty): Faculty directory with research interests, resources, and university service information
- [Current Staff](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/current-staff): Staff directory with HR information and office administration access

## Events and News

- [Computer Science Events](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/events): Upcoming seminars and lectures in AI, robotics, theory, game design, and other research areas
- [News + Stories](https://cs.cornell.edu/news-stories/featured): Featured stories on AI research, robotics, computer vision innovation, and faculty achievements

## External Engagement

- [Information for Media](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/information-media): Media relations contacts and faculty expert information for press inquiries
